recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, back-view shot of a performer facing a dense crowd illuminated by hundreds of glowing phone lights, processed with heavy film grain, dust scratches, and a desaturated, cool-toned color grade.
coreVisualRelationships: The central silhouette of the performer anchors the lower-middle frame.
The sea of bokeh-style phone lights creates a rhythmic, sparkling background.
The handwritten script floats in the upper third, contrasting with the busy crowd texture.
Heavy analog noise and dust overlays unify the foreground and background elements.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and surface scratches

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure in the lower half, cropped at the waist, acting as a dark silhouette against the bright crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the performer's back and shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the dark central figure upward to the bright phone lights and finally to the floating script at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with light points and texture, though the upper-left corner is slightly darker.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and desaturated blues in the shadows and performer's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm white and pale yellow for the phone light bokeh.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale cyan-white for the handwritten typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark silhouette and the pinpricks of light.
paletteRestrictions: No clean blacks; all darks must have noise/grain

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a casual, hand-drawn feel.
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated loops on capitals
Slightly shaky, organic line quality as if written with a chalk or gel pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'P' and 'L' feature large, open loops
The numeral '4' is simplified and integrated into the script flow

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the 'sky' area above the crowd

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone script against a complex photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the original.
Captures the slightly textured, monolinear stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, low-light photo from behind a performer looking at a stadium crowd. The crowd is a sea of glowing phone lights (bokeh). Apply heavy film grain, dust, and a desaturated blue/grey color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom-lettered cursive script in the upper third of the image using an off-white color with a subtle grainy texture.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's back facing the camera?
Are there hundreds of small light points in the background?
Is the texture heavily distressed with grain and scratches?
Is the text in a thin, handwritten cursive style?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
Any recognizable brand logos on phones or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure grain is consistent across text and image
Verify the bokeh effect doesn't overpower the silhouette
Confirm the script looks hand-drawn, not typed
recipe.reuseFormula: Back-view performer + bokeh crowd lights + heavy film grain + floating hand-script = Gritty Concert Aesthetic.
